entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: An elder demon freed from the Abyss who led the Cabal of Dominaria until slain by Liliana Vess with the Blackblade.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who dealt with four demons after the Mending and slew Belzenlok with the Blackblade.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event after which four demons dealt with Liliana Vess.

entities.name: War of the Abyss
entities.description: A war in which Belzenlok fought before being stuck in the Abyss.

entities.name: The Abyss
entities.description: The place where Belzenlok was stuck until freed.

entities.name: The Cabal of Dominaria
entities.description: A cult that accidentally freed Belzenlok while trying to summon Kuberr.

entities.name: The First
entities.description: A figure whose demise left the Cabal desperate for leadership.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: The being the Cabal tried to summon.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship whose crew struck against the Cabal Stronghold.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who infiltrated the Stronghold and seized the Blackblade.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A legendary sword used by Liliana to slay Belzenlok.

entities.name: Cabal Stronghold
entities.description: The Cabal's fortress, struck by the Weatherlight and crew.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An immortal sky pirate who took the Blackblade from Belzenlok in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A sinister figure with whom Belzenlok aligned in the Echoverse.

events.summary: The Cabal tried to summon Kuberr but accidentally freed Belzenlok from the Abyss.
events.quote: but accidentally freed Belzenlok from the Abyss

events.summary: Belzenlok began rewriting history with himself as lead and subjugated much of Dominaria.
events.quote: began the process of rewriting history with himself as the lead

events.summary: Gideon Jura infiltrated the Stronghold and seized the Blackblade while the Weatherlight and crew struck.
events.quote: The Planeswalker Gideon Jura infiltrated the Stronghold and seized control of the Blackblade

events.summary: Liliana Vess used the Blackblade to slay Belzenlok and end his reign.
events.quote: Liliana Vess used the legendary sword to slay Belzenlok and end his reign

relations.quote: Liliana Vess used the legendary sword to slay Belzenlok and end his reign

relations.note: Began rewriting history as part of the Cabal.
relations.quote: As part of the Cabal, the Demonlord began the process of rewriting history

relations.note: Killed in a strike by the skyship and crew.
relations.quote: he was ultimately killed in a strike against the Cabal Stronghold by the skyship Weatherlight and its crew

relations.note: In the Echoverse she took the Blackblade from him.
relations.quote: the Blackblade was still taken from him during the war by the immortal sky pirate Jhoira
